name: dotclaude
description: Lists the dotclaude plugin and its optional code-graph, Jev, browser, and docs plugins.

plugins.name: dotclaude
plugins.description: Adds guards against destructive commands and weakened tests, secret redaction, model and effort rules for subagents, a handoff note before compaction, cache notes, working rules, and role agents.

plugins.name: dotclaude-codegraph
plugins.description: Gives Claude the code graph of a project from the CodeGraph CLI `codegraph`. Syncs the index, and adds callers and definitions to `Grep` and `Glob` calls.

plugins.name: dotclaude-jev
plugins.description: Adds a second-opinion tool that asks TypeSafe Jev, a decision model, about a decision. With no `TYPESAFE_API_KEY`, the tool sends Claude to the `reviewer` agent.

plugins.name: dotclaude-browser
plugins.description: Drives a browser with `agent-browser`, or with CloakBrowser on sites with bot detection. Answers each `WebSearch` call with a search in the headless browser.

plugins.name: dotclaude-docs
plugins.description: Gets current library and API docs with the Context7 CLI `ctx7`. Works with no key.
